data.current_description: Changes one or more of a monitor's editable fields through the same domain path as the dashboard's own edit forms. At least one field must be present.
data.description_suggestion: Updates one or more editable monitor fields. All fields are optional; omitted fields remain untouched. Partial updates are supported. Input validation is type-specific: `url` applies to Website/API/External Status Page monitors; `host` applies to Ping/IP/Port/DNS/SSL Certificate/Domain monitors; `request_timeout_seconds` applies to Website/API monitors (null restores 30-second default); `failure_threshold` is refused for Manual, Incoming Request and Incoming Email monitors; `heartbeat_interval_minutes` and `heartbeat_grace_minutes` apply only to Incoming Request monitors (dead-man's-switch settings). The `description` field accepts null to clear it. At least one field must be present in the request. Returns the updated monitor object.
